Package backend.classes

Class Inventory

java.lang.Object
backend.classes.Inventory
public class Inventory extends Object
Represents a single inventory item in the system.

Each Inventory object stores details about a product used in operations, including its name, serving count, restock threshold, current stock level, vendor information, and unit cost.

This class is primarily used by inventory management and reporting features to track stock levels, detect low-stock conditions, and update quantities after sales or restocking events.
